sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed by the applicant apprehending his arrest in F.I.R. No. 0307 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467,
468 Indian Penal Code, Police Station Sandila, District Hardoi.
Issue notice to respondent no.2.

It is alleged in the prosecution case that the applicant by committing forgery and by creating fake group in the name of Jai Balaji Swayam Sahayata Samuh, opened account in Punjab National Bank and has withdrawn Rs.684512/- with connivance of the bank employees.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant and the complainant are real brother and sister.
Both have created group.
The complainant was the Director and the applicant was the Deputy Director.
The alleged incident is of 6.10.2012 and First Information Report has been lodged in the year 2022 after delay of ten years.
He submits that delay in lodging the Fist Information Report has not been explained by the informant.
The allegations are concocted.
No reason has been assigned as to why the complainant remained quite for a period of ten years.
The applicant has no criminal antecedent.
During investigation Section 467 and 468 I.P.C. has been dropped by the Investigating Officer.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has cooperated in the investigation and further undertakes to cooperate in the trial.
Charge-sheet in the case has been filed.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer, however, does not dispute the fact that Section 467, 468 I.P.C. has been dropped.
Issue notice to respondent No. 2 returnable at an early date.
Learned Addl.
Government Advocate prays for and is allowed fifteen days' time to file counter affidavit.

On due consideration to the arguments advanced; perusal of the record; considering the fact that the incident took place in the year 2012; First Information Report has been lodged after ten years without explaining; the applicant has no criminal antecedent and also considering the judgment in Sushila Aggarwal and others versus State (NCT of Delhi) and another (2020)5 SCC 1 and without entering into the merit of the case, it would be appropriate to grant interim protection to the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: Till the next date of listing, it is provided that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
The applicant shall cooperate in the trial and he will not influence the witnesses.
The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant shall further cooperate in the investigation.

Learned AGA has submitted that investigation in the matter is going on, however, he could not show from the material on record that the applicant is not cooperating in the investigation and has not misused the liberty of bail granted by this Court.

On due consideration to the fact that there is nothing on record to show that the applicant is not cooperating in the trial as well as considering the undertaking given by the applicant that she will cooperate in the investigation, the interim protection granted by this Court vide order dated 27.02.2023 is made absolute in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.
